messages:
zoe: flagging a sampling concern for the mini-benchwe may be overfitting to frequent patterns. proposing we add a rare-token & entity stress case and an explicit golden-rotation cadence.

paul: +1. current anchors skew short conversational english. need multilingual and edge-token coverage (emoji, zwnj, CJK).

hema: agree. suggest stratified sampling with weights: short 50%, med 30%, long 15%, rare-edge 5%. rare-edge should include: very long tokens, unusual unicode, numeric-heavy prompts, and low-resource language snippets.

chris: operational tradeoff: rare-edge drives bench runtime and flakiness. can we run rare-edge only in async path or as a weekly sweep instead of on every mini-bench?

zoe: plan: keep fast-pass focused on short/med/long daily; trigger rare-edge when model touches our "wide-token" flag or weekly rotation. rare-edge failures should be high-severity but not immediate block unless tokenizer mismatch.

paul: metrics: for each bucket emit tokenization-diff, top1-stability, and token-coverage-percent. add a new metric: "anchor-coverage" that says how many golden tokens matched.

hema: for golden rotation: rotate one anchor per bucket weekly and run a background replay comparing last 4 rotations to surface drift trends. keep rotation PRs reviewed by eng-ml and translations team.

chris: on drift alerts: if weekly drift exceeds thresholds (top1 drop >6% or tokenization diffs increased by >3), auto-create a regression ticket and mark model as "suspect" in registry.

audit-bot: note: models onboarded under enterprise contracts must record rotation provenance. add "signed-rotation-manifest" to audit logs.

zoe: privacy ask: for private deployments we can't upload reports. add "local-only" mode that returns signed decision blobs and an opaque report hash that audit can verify later.

paul: sampling reproducibility: store seeds per run and store the exact input selection snapshot in the run artifact. include seed in the mini-report so QA can replay.

hema: edge-case: quantized models can change tokenization boundaries in rare cases due to tokenizer pre/postprocessing differences. add a targeted quantization token check that compares raw bytes pre/post decode for anchors.

chris: UX: console should show a small sparklines view of weekly drift per bucket and a one-click diff that shows the top 5 changed tokens and the positions. keep it lightweight.

zoe: I'll draft the sampling policy doc and the rotation schedule and add examples for rare-edge cases. will include the local-only contract for private. tagging @paul @hema for review.

paul: will review. can we also add a canary-path for soft-warn models where rare-edge fails but daily passesroute 0.1% traffic for 48h with monitor hooks.

hema: +1. I'll enumerate thresholds and produce a short table.

zoe: great. I'll open the PR and a 30m sync next Tue. thanks all!
